import 'dart:convert';
import 'dart:io';

import 'package:adele_environment/adele_environment.dart';

import 'prepared_environment_capability_support.dart';

// A implements only Environment. It has no probe Capability contract or client.
Future<void> main(List<String> arguments, Object? bootstrapMessage) =>
    runProbeBackend(
      arguments,
      bootstrapMessage,
      (state) => {
        'shared': {
          environmentProviderServiceId: EnvironmentProviderServiceDispatcher(
            EnvironmentService(state),
            concurrent: true,
          ),
        },
      },
    );

class EnvironmentService implements EnvironmentProviderService {
  EnvironmentService(this.state);
  final ProbeState state;
  final _environments = <String, String>{};
  final _roots = <String, String>{};

  @override
  Future<EnvironmentProviderTransportResult> establish(
    EnvironmentTransportContext environment,
  ) => restore(environment);

  @override
  Future<EnvironmentProviderTransportResult> restore(
    EnvironmentTransportContext environment,
  ) async {
    _environments[environment.environmentId] = environment.providerId;
    _roots[environment.environmentId] =
        environment.providerState['root'] as String;
    await state.checkpoint('restore:${environment.environmentId}');
    return EnvironmentProviderTransportResult(
      providerState: environment.providerState,
      initialState: null,
    );
  }

  @override
  Future<EnvironmentTextFile> readFile(
    String environmentId,
    String relativePath,
  ) async {
    // This fixture exposes direct child files only. Confinement belongs to A,
    // never to the callable or to host inference from an Environment identity.
    if (relativePath.isEmpty ||
        relativePath == '.' ||
        relativePath == '..' ||
        relativePath.contains('/') ||
        relativePath.contains('\\')) {
      throw EnvironmentFailure(
        code: 'invalid_path',
        message: 'Only direct child files are supported.',
        details: const {},
      );
    }
    final provider = _environments[environmentId]!;
    state.reads.add({
      'environmentId': environmentId,
      'providerId': provider,
      'path': relativePath,
    });
    await state.checkpoint('read:$relativePath');
    if (relativePath == 'host-failure') {
      throw EnvironmentFailure(
        code: 'read_failure',
        message: 'SECRET read failure',
        details: const {},
      );
    }
    final bytes = await File('${_roots[environmentId]}/$relativePath')
        .openRead(0, 1025)
        .fold<List<int>>([], (buffer, chunk) => buffer..addAll(chunk));
    if (bytes.length > 1024)
      throw StateError('Fixture file exceeds its bound.');
    final text = utf8.decode(bytes);
    return EnvironmentTextFile(
      relativePath: relativePath,
      text: text,
      sizeBytes: bytes.length,
      revision: '$environmentId-revision',
    );
  }

  @override
  dynamic noSuchMethod(Invocation invocation) =>
      throw UnsupportedError('Read only.');
}
